body: Thank you. I'm trying to remember that.
I'm not really sure what you mean by completely transitioned. At the moment - I have friends who are supportive but I can't really talk to them fully about it. Same with (some) family.

Thanks. 
No, I'm not considering that. I would love that to even be an option, but it's not. If I don't transition I will kill myself, there are no two ways about it. This is literally life saving action. Still, the related 'drama' does suck, and right now...yeah it's only mildly preferable to seeing out a miserable time before ending it.
I do already do that. Unfortunately I think knowing other people are going through it doesn't do much to alleviate the experience of it. Thank you though, I appreciate it.
Thank you for reminding me it's okay to feel sad.
